# Email Intelligence MCP

Find, verify, and pattern-detect business email addresses for AI agents doing outbound sales, recruitment, and lead generation.

## When to call

Use this MCP when you need to:
- Find a person's business email from their name and company domain
- Verify an email address is deliverable before sending outreach
- Detect what email format a company uses (first.last@domain vs fLast@domain)

## Tools

| Tool | Price | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| find_email | $0.05 | Find email from name + domain using Hunter.io → Clearbit → pattern waterfall |
| verify_email | $0.02 | Verify deliverability via MX lookup + SMTP connectivity check |
| detect_pattern | $0.02 | Detect company email format from domain using WHOIS + common patterns |

## Example AI Prompt

"Find the email address for Sarah Chen at Stripe, if it exists."

## Example AI Prompt

"Verify these emails before we send the campaign: john@company.com, jane@company.com, invalid-email@not-a-domain.xyz"

## Example AI Prompt

"What is the email format at Shopify? Are they using first.last or first.last@shopify.com?"

---

## MCP Server Details

**Endpoint:** `https://email-intelligence-mcp.apify.actor/mcp`
**Apify Store:** https://apify.com/red-cars-io/email-intelligence-mcp

## Quick Start

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "email-intelligence-mcp": {
      "url": "https://email-intelligence-mcp.apify.actor/mcp?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN"
    }
  }
}
```

No API key required for basic MX verification. AI agents can call tools directly via the MCP protocol.

## Data Sources

| Source | Records |
|--------|---------|
| Hunter.io | Email finder + domain search (free tier) |
| Clearbit | Person/company data (free tier) |
| DNS/MX | Built-in Node.js |
| WHOIS | Company name lookup |
